look_here_first: Inspect the intact umbel spathe: usually 3–4 bracts with 3–7 veins each. Check flowers versus aerial bulbils; their absence does not exclude this variable species.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Basal linear leaves 20–50 cm long, 1–7 mm wide.

key_traits.label: Umbel
key_traits.text: Loose cluster with 0–60 flowers; bulbils often present, but variable.
